extracted.name: Best White Icing Ever
extracted.description: This Crisco frosting is easy to make with shortening and confectioners' sugar for a bright white icing that can be used on cookies or cakes.
instruction_lines: Place confectioners' sugar, shortening, water, and vanilla into a large bowl. Beat with an electric mixer on low speed to combine, then beat on medium speed for a full 5 minutes.
